title: Procedure Inference as Memory: Learning Recruiter Decision Procedures from OKF-Structured Episodes in Multi-Session Hiring Assistants
abstract: arXiv:2611.34576v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multi-session hiring assistants must infer evolving recruiter preferences and decision patterns across projects and time. We introduce Open Knowledge Format (OKF)-indexed episodic memory to organize interactions and retrieve related events through their lineage. We also introduce Procedure Memory, which learns reusable decision procedures from these episodes through prompted reflection or reinforcement learning. We compare these approaches with no memory, full-history context, and conversation search, and evaluate Jev-class models for index navigation and GPT-5.6 Luna as a lower-cost alternative to GPT-5.4.   In our evaluation, OKF-indexed retrieval achieves low-priority preference F1 scores of 0.93-0.95 at medium and high preference overlap between hiring projects. It significantly outperforms full-history context and conversation search in both settings, and no memory at high overlap, while using 69% fewer context tokens than full hist

translated_title: 程序推断即记忆：在多会话招聘助手中从OKF结构化情节中学习招聘者决策程序
translated_abstract: 多会话招聘助手必须跨项目和时间推断不断演变的招聘者偏好和决策模式。我们引入了开放知识格式（OKF）索引的情节记忆，用于组织交互并通过其谱系检索相关事件。我们还引入了程序记忆，它通过提示反思或强化学习从这些情节中学习可复用的决策程序。我们将这些方法与无记忆、全历史上下文和对话搜索进行比较，并评估了用于索引导航的Jev类模型以及作为GPT-5.4低成本替代方案的GPT-5.6 Luna。在我们的评估中，OKF索引检索在招聘项目之间中度和高度偏好重叠的情况下，实现了0.93-0.95的低优先级偏好F1分数。它在两种设置下都显著优于全历史上下文和对话搜索，在高重叠情况下优于无记忆，同时比全历史上下文少使用69%的上下文token。
tldr: 该论文提出了OKF索引的情节记忆和程序记忆，使多会话招聘助手能够从历史情节中学习可复用的招聘者决策程序，在显著减少上下文token使用的同时大幅优于全历史上下文和对话搜索等基线方法。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces OKF-indexed episodic memory and Procedure Memory, enabling multi-session hiring assistants to learn reusable recruiter decision procedures from historical episodes, significantly outperforming full-history context and conversation search while using 69% fewer context tokens.
